name: Active Scanning
description: Adversaries probe victim infrastructure via network traffic to gather information for targeting.

name: Network Service Discovery
description: Adversaries enumerate services running on remote hosts and network devices to find exploitable targets.

name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries systematically guess passwords or credentials when they are unknown.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries use credentials of existing accounts to gain access, persist, or escalate.

name: Remote Services
description: Adversaries use valid accounts to log into services designed for remote access such as SSH, RDP and SMB.

name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
description: Adversaries communicate over DNS to blend in with normal traffic or tunnel data.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Adversaries steal data by sending it over their existing command and control channel.

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
description: Adversaries steal data using a protocol different from the main command and control channel.

name: Non-Standard Port
description: Adversaries communicate over a protocol and port pairing not typically associated, to evade filtering.

name: Proxy
description: Adversaries use a connection proxy to direct network traffic between systems or hide the true destination.
